versions.changelog:
Initial release of funding-arb-scan:

- Instantly scans and ranks 15 Binance USD-M alts by absolute funding APR, including crowded long/short flags.
- Includes BTC/ETH/SOL regime analysis in the same pay-per-request.
- No API key, signup, or subscription required; simple HTTP endpoint with USDC micropayments (Base, x402).
- Enables quick cash-and-carry idea generation, squeeze-risk checks, or funding regime queries without running your own infra.
- Clear flags help identify liquidation risk from crowding before executing arbitrage strategies.
